title: Zk Op
tagline: Zero Knowledge OP is a DAPP that collects polls from subject while maintaining subject anonymity and automatically, register a likely vote based on the poll questions.
description:
Zero Knowledge Vote is a DApp to facilitate anonymous polling and voting processes. The DApp uses ZKP protocols to maintain user anonymity throughout the polling process.

Users participate in the polling process by responding to a series of in-depth questions regarding their preferences, priorities, and values related to a specific topic, such as candidate selection for an election. If the user is undecided, the DApp registers the most-likely vote based on an AI model.
